# Workspace Instructions

- Project: Next.js video platform with profile downloads, premium upgrade flow, and Razorpay test checkout.
- Preserve the pastel glassmorphism visual style defined in `app/globals.css`.
- Keep the app Vercel-ready and prefer App Router patterns.
- Store local download history in browser storage and keep premium state durable across refreshes.
- Use Razorpay only through the API routes and env vars documented in `README.md`.
